columns.label: The blue
head: A color with
a story.
A color with
a story.
columns.body: The tools were red when Park Tool made them for Schwinn dealers. When Park Tool began selling to every shop, it switched to blue, and the blue is now a registered trademark.

columns.label: The standard
head: The brand the
industry trusts.
The brand the
industry trusts.
columns.body: Shimano, SRAM and Race Face bring their new parts to Park Tool. Eric Hawkins called the company “Switzerland” in 2015.

columns.label: The teacher
head: Where riders
learn.
Where riders
learn.
columns.body: Calvin Jones taught a generation of riders for 28 years. The Big Blue Book is in its fourth edition, with nearly 200 Repair Help guides and 158 million YouTube views.

columns.label: The origin
head: A stand from
a St. Paul shop.
A stand from
a St. Paul shop.
columns.body: Howard Hawkins and Art Engstrom built a repair stand in the back of their St. Paul bike shop. Park Tool was founded in 1963, and Eric Hawkins, Howard’s son, runs it today.

sections.note: Bikerumor interview with Eric Hawkins, Jun 22, 2015. Trademark: parktool.com. Calvin Jones: Park Tool News, Jan 6, 2026. Guides and the Big Blue Book: Bicycle Retailer, Jan 6, 2026. sections.sub: Calvin Jones retired in January after 28 years. The teaching that built the brand needs a voice of its own, and this is the moment to decide what it says.
